adequacy_evidence.quote: Scientific adequacy: **supported**. The reported absence of positive whole-brain-corrected vmPFC support is supported by a suitable directional group analysis, with clear coverage, anatomical, uncertainty and upstream-model limits.

hypothesis_conclusion.quote: The supplied gain-effect maps do **not support a positive vmPFC response** in the NARPS equal-indifference group under whole-brain family-wise error (FWE) control.
